name: twig-toolbox
description: Twig language support for VS Code: syntax highlighting and a language server, with first-class Craft CMS awareness.

twigToolbox.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Twig Toolbox language server.

twigToolbox.diagnostics.unknownNames.description: Controls diagnostics for unknown Twig tag, filter, function, and test names.

twigToolbox.diagnostics.ignoredNames.description: Twig tag, filter, function, and test names ignored by unknown-name diagnostics.

twigToolbox.templateRoots.description: Template root directories, relative to the workspace folder unless absolute. Auto-detected roots are used when empty.

twigToolbox.autoClosingTags.description: Automatically closes HTML tags in Twig files.

twigToolbox.autoCreateQuotes.description: Automatically adds quotes after typing '=' in an HTML attribute in Twig files.

twigToolbox.autoClosingBraces.description: Automatically closes braces and brackets typed inside a Twig expression, such as the hash in '{% set a = { %}' and the array in '{% set a = [ %}'.
